stemMarkdown: Two runners start together from the same point on a circular track 900 m long and run in opposite directions at 4.5 km/h and 6.5 km/h. After how many seconds do they meet for the first time? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Running in opposite directions their speeds add: $3.0556$ m/s. Together they must cover one full lap, so they meet after $\dfrac{900}{3.0556} = 294.5455$ seconds.
